entries.odia: ରଖେ ହରି ମାରେ କିଏ? ମାରେ ହରି ରଖେ କିଏ?
entries.title: Who can overrule Hari?
entries.literal_meaning: If Hari protects, who can kill? If Hari kills, who can protect?
entries.explanation: The mirrored questions express faith in divine authority over life and death. Repeating the same verbs in reverse makes the speaker’s conviction sound absolute. It may voice surrender when human control feels limited; that use is an editorial reading, not a documented origin.
entries.meaning_odia: ହରି ରଖିଲେ କିଏ ମାରିବ, ହରି ମାରିଲେ କିଏ ରଖିବ? ଦୁଇ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନରେ ସେହି ଶବ୍ଦର ସ୍ଥାନ ବଦଳି ଭକ୍ତିର ବିଶ୍ୱାସକୁ ଦୃଢ଼ କରେ। ନିଜ ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣର ସୀମା ଅନୁଭବ କରୁଥିବା ବକ୍ତାଙ୍କ ସମର୍ପଣ ଭାବେ ଏହାକୁ ପଢ଼ାଯାଇପାରେ।
entries.english_summary: The mirrored questions express faith in divine authority over life and death.
entries.odia_summary: ହରି ରଖିଲେ କିଏ ମାରିବ, ହରି ମାରିଲେ କିଏ ରଖିବ? ଦୁଇ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନରେ ସେହି ଶବ୍ଦର ସ୍ଥାନ ବଦଳି ଭକ୍ତିର ବିଶ୍ୱାସକୁ ଦୃଢ଼ କରେ।
entries.usage_example: After an uncertain journey ends safely, a believer expresses gratitude with this saying. (Original imagined example.)
entries.cultural_context: Religious conviction, not a factual prediction or reason to withhold care. Source labels the example Dhaga but supplies no separate situational gloss.

entries.title: A tiger among tulsi plants
entries.literal_meaning: A tiger in a tulsi garden.
entries.explanation: The source imagines a cat claiming a tiger’s stature in a small setting. It mocks someone displaying modest knowledge as great authority where others cannot readily challenge it. The target is inflated self-importance, not the worth of people with less schooling.
entries.meaning_odia: ଛୋଟ ତୁଳସୀ ବଣରେ ବିରାଡ଼ି ନିଜକୁ ବାଘ ଭାବୁଛି—ଅଭିଧାନର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାର ଛବି ଏହି। ଅଳ୍ପ ଜାଣି ମଧ୍ୟ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରିବା ଲୋକ ନଥିବା ଜାଗାରେ ବଡ଼ ପଣ୍ଡିତ ସାଜିବାକୁ ଏହା ଟାହି କରେ। କମ୍ ପାଠ ପଢ଼ିଥିବା ଲୋକଙ୍କୁ ତୁଚ୍ଛ କରିବା ଏହି ପାଠର ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: The source imagines a cat claiming a tiger’s stature in a small setting.
entries.odia_summary: ଛୋଟ ତୁଳସୀ ବଣରେ ବିରାଡ଼ି ନିଜକୁ ବାଘ ଭାବୁଛି—ଅଭିଧାନର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାର ଛବି ଏହି।
entries.usage_example: A novice gives absolute technical advice to beginners, then avoids an experienced person’s questions. (Original imagined example.)
entries.cultural_context: Historical gloss uses demeaning educational/status labels; retained meaning is criticism of inflated authority, with those labels not endorsed. Cat/tiger scene is figurative, not animal-behaviour evidence.

entries.title: Such a grand household, such stinginess
entries.literal_meaning: Pumpkin vine! A son of a grand household, so miserly!
entries.explanation: The rhyme of ଡ଼ଙ୍କ and ରଙ୍କ gives the complaint a teasing snap. A grand household suggests resources, yet its son behaves as though even a small contribution is too much. The joke exposes that mismatch between the family’s impressive image and the person’s stinginess. Here the dictionary places ରଙ୍କ under “miserly”, not “poor”; lack of generosity and lack of money must not be confused.
entries.meaning_odia: କଖାରୁଡ଼ଙ୍କ ସହ ରଙ୍କର ମିଳ ଅଭିଯୋଗଟିକୁ ଟାହିର ସ୍ୱର ଦିଏ। ବଡ଼ଘରର ପୁଅ ବୋଲି ନାମ ଅଛି, ଅଥଚ ସାମାନ୍ୟ କିଛି ଦେବାକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ହାତ ଖୋଲୁନାହିଁ—ହସଟି ଏହି ଅମେଳରେ। ଘରର ବଡ଼ ନାମ ଓ ମଣିଷର ଛୋଟ ବ୍ୟବହାରକୁ ପାଖାପାଖି ରଖି କଥାଟି କହାଯାଇପାରେ। ଏଠି ରଙ୍କର ଅଭିଧାନ ଅର୍ଥ କୃପଣ; ଟଙ୍କାର ଅଭାବକୁ କୃପଣତା ସହ ମିଶାଇବା ଠିକ୍ ହେବ ନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: A grand family name makes a small act of stinginess look all the more ridiculous.
entries.odia_summary: ବଡ଼ଘରର ନାମ ଓ ସାମାନ୍ୟ ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚରେ କୃପଣତା—ଏହି ଅମେଳକୁ କଥାଟି ଟାହି କରେ।
entries.usage_example: At a shared picnic, someone boasts about the size of his family home but refuses to contribute even a few cups. A friend says, “କଖାରୁଡ଼ଙ୍କ ! ବଡ଼ଘରପୁଅ ଏଡ଼ିକି ରଙ୍କ !” The teasing targets his conduct, not someone unable to afford a contribution. (Original imagined example.)
entries.cultural_context: Source sense1 supports stinginess. The household label is the speaker’s taunt, not a rule about class.

entries.title: Whose choice is the meal?
entries.literal_meaning: Does the needy person’s wish decide the meal?
entries.explanation: Wanting a meal and being able to choose it are different things. The source explains that someone dependent on another’s food receives what the giver wishes to provide. The question can expose how little say the recipient has. Its tone matters: it may describe that constraint sympathetically, or dismiss the person’s wishes. This reading draws attention to limited choice without endorsing that dismissal.
entries.meaning_odia: ଭୋକ ଲାଗିବା ଓ ନିଜ ଇଚ୍ଛାର ଖାଦ୍ୟ ବାଛିପାରିବା ଏକା କଥା ନୁହେଁ। ଅନ୍ୟର ଦାନ ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭର କଲେ ଦାତା ଯାହା ଦେବେ, ସେତିକି ହିଁ ମିଳିପାରେ—ଅଭିଧାନର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ଏହାକୁ କହେ। ପ୍ରଶ୍ନଟି ସେହି ଅସହାୟତାକୁ ବୁଝି କୁହାଯାଇପାରେ, ପୁଣି କାହାର ଇଚ୍ଛାକୁ ତୁଚ୍ଛ କରିବାକୁ ବି ବ୍ୟବହାର ହୋଇପାରେ। ଏଠାରେ ଆମେ ବାଛିବାର ସୁଯୋଗ କମିଯିବାକୁ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ କରୁଛୁ, ଅଭାବରେ ଥିବା ଲୋକଙ୍କ କଥାକୁ ଅଗ୍ରାହ୍ୟ କରିବାକୁ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Depending on another’s provision can leave little room for one’s own choice.
entries.odia_summary: ଅନ୍ୟର ଦାନ ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭର କଲେ ନିଜ ଇଚ୍ଛାରେ ବାଛିବାର ସୁଯୋଗ କମିଯାଇପାରେ।
entries.usage_example: At a relief kitchen, a family asks whether a different meal is available, but only one prepared dish can be served. Afterwards a recipient says, “ରଙ୍କ ଇଚ୍ଛାରେ କି ଭୋଜନ?” to express having no choice, not to praise the arrangement. (Original imagined example.)
entries.cultural_context: Historical need/dependence language; do not turn it into a demand for unquestioning gratitude.
